title: Potatoes in beds or large containers
subcategory: Potatoes in beds or large containers
summary: Grow potatoes from suitable seed material while preventing light exposure and rot.
steps: Use certified or otherwise trusted disease-free seed potatoes rather than unknown discarded tubers.
Plant in loose drained soil with enough depth and spacing.
As stems grow, hill clean soil or suitable medium around them without burying all foliage.
Keep developing tubers covered from light; green tubers are not food.
Harvest after the intended maturity in dry conditions where possible and cure only sound tubers before dark ventilated storage.
